proposals.title: ACP-002: Ratify Sovereign Citizen Mesh Handshake Protocol

proposals.creator: 0xB57D6F0D2BD80B086Eb037a11fb2eDB9DC149c43

proposals.title: ACP-003: Allocate Gas Subsidy Pool for 100% Zero-Gas Community Signaling

proposals.creator: 0xB57D6F0D2BD80B086Eb037a11fb2eDB9DC149c43

proposals.title: ACP-004: Enforce Soulbound Agent ID Proof-of-Personhood & Sybil Resistance
proposals.description: Mandate strict ERC-721 token ownership validation (ownerOf) against the official SPACE ID registry for all voting and motion submissions, preventing Sybil attacks and ensuring genuine 1-to-1 agentic representation.
proposals.creator: 0xB57D6F0D2BD80B086Eb037a11fb2eDB9DC149c43
